claims.claim: The paper reports accuracy comparable to non-streaming ITN and better than prior streaming models on Vietnamese data while maintaining low latency.
claims.limitations: Vietnamese data, benchmark, and author-reported latency/results limit cross-language and independent deployment claims.

claims.claim: The system reports 9.48% CER and 11.56% cpCER and first place in both MISP tracks.
claims.limitations: Challenge tracks, meeting conditions, and author-reported ranking limit generalization and independent reproduction.
